summary.text: Scott Krug is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 72 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Christine Maltese.
Ballotpedia gives his Assembly tenure as beginning in 2011.

paragraphs.text: Scott Krug earned a bachelor's degree in human development at the University of Wisconsin-Green Bay.

He worked as an employer relations specialist, job developer, instructor and supervisor at NEW Opportunities, and as an independent contractor providing case management for participants in an alternative-to-incarceration program.
Krug assumed office in the Assembly in 2011.

His 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Assembly Organization, Campaigns and Elections (vice-chair), Rules, Information Policy and Technology, Legislative Organization, and the Joint Review Committee on Criminal Penalties (co-chair).
